conclusions.text: The retrieved 1894 official Gazette text records the 26 June 1893 Lunda tracing, its ratification and effective date, and states that detailed approved limits are in five earlier commission minutes.

Candidate-scale product labels are local observations only. All ten component whole-footprint water statuses and causal classifications remain unknown; all five contact polygons remain complete, pinned context with unknown water and boundary-authority status.

The finite 1893 treaty segments have not been matched to any of the ten components. The 1894 text lacks the referenced minutes/maps, and the official archives catalog is only a locator; modern boundary authority remains unresolved.
The Sentinel scene choice is reproducible among saved first-page search hits only; the larger numberMatched item set was not fully enumerated.
